statement: Build a one-file, mobile-first website for the Spark 2026 tech fest at Northfield College of Engineering, Pune (14 to 16 February 2027) where students can see the schedule by day, browse events by category, register for an event, see sponsors, find the venue and contact the organisers on WhatsApp.
audience: College students, mostly on phones, deciding which fest events to attend and register for.
standards: Energetic, modern look: dark background, bright accent colours, bold large headings
Phone-first layout that also works on desktop
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Photos shown as clearly labelled placeholders
rules: Use only the facts the Requester supplied; never invent events, times, prices, rooms, sponsors or contact details
Show no room or place per event, since none was supplied
Sponsors are shown by name only, no logos
Registration details go by email to spark2026@example.com
done_when: The page shows the name Spark 2026, Northfield College of Engineering, Pune, and the dates 14 to 16 February 2027.

A schedule section has three switchable day views (Day 1 14 Feb, Day 2 15 Feb, Day 3 16 Feb) listing each event on its correct day with its start and end time: Day 1 Code Sprint 10am-1pm, Line Follower 2pm-5pm, AI in Daily Life 5:30pm-6:30pm; Day 2 Bug Hunt 11am-1pm, Poster Jam 2pm-4pm; Day 3 Drone Dash 10am-1pm, UI Duel 2pm-5pm, Startup Stories 5:30pm-6:30pm.

An events section can be filtered by category (Coding, Robotics, Design, Talks) and shows each event with its fee: Code Sprint Rs 100, Bug Hunt Rs 50, Line Follower Rs 150, Drone Dash Rs 200, Poster Jam free, UI Duel Rs 100, AI in Daily Life free, Startup Stories free.

A registration form has required fields for name, email and college, plus an event dropdown listing all eight events; submitting it sends the details to spark2026@example.com and shows the student a success or error message.
A sponsors section lists Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs and Pixel Press as text names with no logos.
A venue section shows the address 'Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007' and a link that opens it in Google Maps.
A WhatsApp button links to wa.me/910000033333 (+91 00000 33333), and the email spark2026@example.com is shown as a contact.
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: See the schedule day by day
Register for an event with a form
